notices.protect-sync-active: Sync is on. Hiding is skipped to avoid deleting files on other devices.
notices.protect-sync-inactive: Sync is still on. Hiding is no longer skipped, hiding hidden files will now delete them on other synced devices.

settings.protect-sync-description: When ON and Obsidian Sync is detected, hiding hidden files is skipped so deletions are not propagated to other devices. Keep this ON in synced vaults: turning it OFF lets hiding delete files on all synced devices (Sync is not a backup). Best-effort; unknown Sync bugs may remain.
settings.protect-sync-status-unknown: Sync not detected, protection still on
settings.protect-sync-status-unprotected: Sync active, protection OFF, deletions will sync
settings.show-hidden-files-description-HTML: 請也啟用檔案與連結 > 偵測所有的副檔名以正常運作。可從命令面板切換。
